top_categories.workout_context: At mile 60 of 99, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
53ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At Clare Classic, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Clare Classic. Train it until it feels boring.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 99 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Clare Classic's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before race day.
5,249ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
Clare Classic's rolling wine-country roads forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 99 miles.
The aerobic base that lets you ride rolling wine-country roads at tempo for 99 miles without cracking. No shortcuts.
5,249ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 99 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 5,249ft of climbing on rolling wine-country roads does to your power file on race day.

race_overlay.heat: If the forecast warrants it, include controlled heat exposure before Clare Classic and rehearse the drinking and electrolyte plan you tolerate in training. Do not introduce a fixed sodium protocol solely from this preview.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Clare Classic’s 99 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Durability, TT Threshold, and Over Under to prepare you for 99 miles of rolling wine-country roads in Clare and the Clare Valley wine region, South Australia, Australia.
